{"pmid":"11206059","title":"Stability and peptide binding specificity of Btk SH2 domain: molecular basis for X-linked agammaglobulinemia.","journal":"Protein Sci","year":2000,"cited_by":34,"is_review":false,"matched":[],"abstract":"X-linked agammaglobulinemia (XLA) is caused by mutations in the Bruton's tyrosine kinase (Btk). {"pmid":"16951917","title":"Four novel and three recurrent mutations of the BTK gene and pathogenic effects of putative splice mutations.","journal":"J Hum Genet","year":2006,"cited_by":5,"is_review":false,"matched":[],"abstract":"X-linked agammaglobulinemia is caused by mutations in the human BTK gene, leading to recurrent pyogenic infections.
